question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**of.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Of" is the correct preposition to use in this context.**
 
• **As it indicates possession or association between the stars and the history**.
 
 
• "Of" is used to indicate belonging to, connected with, or part of something/somebody.
 
• Example: The back of the building, the petals of the flowers.
 
 
 
• The other prepositions do not fit the context of the given sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "among," suggests a distribution or dispersion among a group.
 
• Option 2, "besides," implies a comparison or addition to something else.
 
• Option 3, "up," does not make sense in this context and would not be a suitable preposition to use.
